description: A comprehensive script implementing a cross-platform unit test runner, including test execution, result collection, build management, and reporting functionalities.

classes.name: TestLineReader
classes.description: Reads and stores lines from the test launcher output via an OS pipe, enabling real-time output display and in-memory storage.

classes.name: TestLauncher
classes.description: Manages the thread executing the test launcher, handling initialization, execution, and termination.

classes.name: TestRunner
classes.description: Coordinates the building, execution, and result processing of unit tests across different configurations and platforms.

methods.name: TestLineReader._ReadLines
methods.description: Continuously reads lines from the launcher output pipe, normalizes line endings, and writes to stdout and internal buffer.

methods.name: TestLineReader.Start
methods.description: Starts the thread that reads lines from the output pipe.

methods.name: TestLineReader.Kill
methods.description: Signals the reading thread to stop.

methods.name: TestLineReader.Join
methods.description: Waits for the reading thread to finish.

methods.name: TestLineReader.GetLines
methods.description: Returns all stored output lines as a list.

methods.name: TestLauncher.Start
methods.description: Initializes and starts the launcher thread, performing device setup if supported.

methods.name: TestLauncher.Kill
methods.description: Kills the running launcher process.

methods.name: TestLauncher.Join
methods.description: Waits for the launcher thread to complete.

methods.name: TestLauncher._Run
methods.description: Executes the launcher, captures return status, and handles exceptions.

methods.name: TestLauncher.GetReturnCode
methods.description: Returns the current return code of the launcher process.

methods.name: TestRunner.__init__
methods.description: Initializes the test runner with configuration, platform, and build parameters.

methods.name: TestRunner._Exec
methods.description: Executes a command in a subprocess, optionally capturing output.

methods.name: TestRunner._GetSpecifiedTestTargets
methods.description: Filters and sets up specific test targets based on user input.

methods.name: TestRunner._GetTestTargets
methods.description: Collects all test targets for the current configuration.

methods.name: TestRunner._GetTestFilters
methods.description: Retrieves combined test filters for platform and application.

methods.name: TestRunner._GetAllTestEnvVariables
methods.description: Gathers environment variables for tests.

methods.name: TestRunner.RunTest
methods.description: Runs a specific test target or test case, manages output, and collects results.

methods.name: TestRunner._CollectTestResults
methods.description: Parses test output lines to summarize total, passed, failed, and flaky tests.

methods.name: TestRunner._CollectFailedTests
methods.description: Extracts names of failed tests from output lines.

methods.name: TestRunner._GetFilteredTestList
methods.description: Returns filtered list of tests for a target.

methods.name: TestRunner._ProcessAllTestResults
methods.description: Aggregates and reports overall test run results, including retries for flaky tests.

methods.name: TestRunner.BuildAllTargets
methods.description: Builds all specified test targets and dependencies.

methods.name: TestRunner.RunAllTests
methods.description: Runs all configured test targets, possibly with sharding.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point for the test runner script, parsing arguments, managing build/run flow, and handling signals.
